def choose_move(observation):
    agent = observation.get('agent', {})
    position = agent.get('position', (0, 0))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])

    targets = resources or enemies or border

    def distance(p):
        return abs(p[0] - position[0]) + abs(p[1] - position[1])

    if targets:
        target = min(targets, key=distance)
        dx = target[0] - position[0]
        dy = target[1] - position[1]
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Move towards center of the map if known, else pick a safe move
        dx, dy = 0, 0
        if 'map_size' in observation:
            width, height = observation['map_size']
            center_x, center_y = width // 2, height // 2
            dx = (center_x - position[0]) 
            dy = (center_y - position[1])
            dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
            dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        else:
            dx, dy = 1, 0  # default move
        return [dx, dy]
